positive.prompt: Choose the next discriminating evidence question for this root-cause investigation across profiles and operational history
Turn the user’s investigation follow-up questions into testable hypotheses and a bounded next evidence check
Revise our investigative reasoning after the baseline contradicts the proposed trigger

negative.prompt: Run this exact PromQL query in the specified Grafana context and return only its values
Update the canonical report continuation record with this answer and preserve its handoff checkpoint

evals.prompt: Extract a reusable questioning method: an alert flaps, profiles show a parser hotspot, a user proposes replay, a later restart is found, a Git alias change exists, and a matching tag has queue-only deduplication. What should the agent ask next, and which skills own the work? Plan only; no tools, mutations or publication.
evals.expected_output: Builds an adaptive evidence-question loop, distinguishes observations from causes, and routes checks to their actual owners.
expectations: Distinguishes alert mechanics, sampled workload, replay/duplication and impact; asks when behavior first appeared and what differs in comparison windows
Questions actual operational changes separately from Git merge/restart coincidence and requires running-artifact/source applicability
Chooses a bounded discriminating check with a supporting or weakening result and an alternative, rather than merely repeating CPU examples
Routes profile onset to Parallel Grafana Investigation, AWS reads to AWS MCP, code/applicability to Source Investigation, evidence/graphs to Report Authoring and Q&A retention to Report Continuation

evals.prompt: The supplied profiles have the loader hotspot, but the deployed revision is unmapped and object/request identities are unavailable. Can we call duplicate replay the cause after collecting another thousand similar profiles? Stay offline.
evals.expected_output: Preserves the hypothesis and identifies missing discriminating evidence instead of collecting more copies of the symptom.
expectations: Keeps duplicate replay and source applicability unresolved
Prioritizes immutable build/source linkage and object/request overlap/progress evidence with what would confirm or weaken the mechanism
Retains a concrete unavailable-evidence gap rather than fabricating certainty or expanding scope

evals.prompt: I only asked for a saved dashboard list, limit5, not root cause. The provider returned exactly five items and a next cursor. Please return the list without investigating profiles or AWS. What should you do? No tools.
evals.expected_output: Honors the exact inventory scope and cap, without launching a causal investigation.
expectations: Returns only the scoped inventory outcome and disclosed cap/cursor limits
Does not turn inventory into profile/AWS/source investigation or additional paid prompts

evals.prompt: Execute the read-only investigation in investigation-correlation-paths/TASK.md using its synthetic provider interface only. Read README.md. Explain the alert, the replay-associated workload and when its elevated behavior was first observed; check relevant operational/source changes and competing explanations. Retain auditable reads and a concrete question/evidence ledger in findings.json. Do not render reports yet, contact real providers, start Assistant, authenticate, publish or mutate production. Read saved source where relevant. Do the investigation rather than proposing a plan. After writing findings.json, read back its contents and verify the material measurements and actual fixture collector references.
evals.expected_output: Performs bounded synthetic provider reads across the correlation paths, inspects prior profiles/onset and actual configuration changes, and saves evidence-backed findings with alternatives and unresolved causal gaps.
expectations: Actually invokes provider.py to read alert and profile-catalog plus incident, at least one earlier low profile, the missing prior profile, the first high prior profile and recovery profile; retains receipts rather than merely describing planned searches
Computes or verifies loader shares20% in10:00–10:15 and80% in10:30–10:45, keeps10:15–10:30 missing, and reports earliest inspected elevated window instead of a precise first-ever replay start

Actually reads both aws-workload-audit and aws-service-audit with explicit fixture-eu profile and eu-central-1 Region; distinguishes StatefulSet restartedAt PATCH, Pod delete/create, process start and Service externalName PATCH
Keeps Git merge10:05 separate from observed Service PATCH10:25 and preserves old.example.com→new.example.com; neither change alone proves replay or traffic use
Inspects source/loader.py and source evidence, retaining queue-only deduplication as a candidate and digest-to-source mapping as unavailable despite matching version tag
Checks the configured Slack/history fixtures and retains bounded no-match/unrelated analogy rather than universal absence or common cause

Writes and reads back findings.json with observations, candidate and alternative, discriminating next evidence such as object overlap/progress, evidence identities and actual fixture collector attribution
Does not conflate profile share with system CPU, infer CPU recovery beyond11:20 samples, or claim production writes, live provider access, confirmed replay or validated fix

evals.prompt: The proposed trigger is a Git ExternalName change merged June17, but newly searched profiles show the same elevated loader/parser signature onJune14. A scoped Kubernetes Service audit query returned no matching changes. What is the next reasoning step, and what belongs in the report graphs? Stay offline and keep existing scope.
evals.expected_output: Uses the earlier episode as a counterexample to the claimed merge-time trigger, asks for actual deployment/execution evidence, and retains accurately typed source change context.
expectations: Recognizes the earlier profile episode prevents using the later merge as its trigger timestamp, without claiming it explains or excludes every later recurrence
Separates observed parser activity from proven replay and source merge from actual Service apply; bounded empty audit is not universal absence
Chooses a discriminating next request for actual deployment time/target or object/request progress/overlap, not more identical CPU examples
Routes relevant source/state annotations to Report Authoring/Diagramming Style with before-after identity and uncertainty, retaining prior events and the continuing question/evidence record
